definitions.gloss: laughing too much; excessive laughter; over-laughing
definitions.explanation: The state of laughing excessively, often to the point of physical discomfort like stomach pain or difficulty breathing.

examples.japanese: {笑|わら}いすぎて⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
examples.english: My stomach hurts from laughing too much.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コント→コント：28499_konto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{笑|わら}いすぎて⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Yesterday's comedy sketch made me laugh so hard I cried.

examples.japanese: {笑|わら}いすぎ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できなく→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I laughed so much I couldn't breathe.

notes:
{笑|わら}いすぎ is formed from ⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧ (to laugh) + すぎ (too much), describing the state of having laughed excessively. It can function as a noun ({笑|わら}いすぎで) or be used in the て-form ({笑|わら}いすぎて).

FORMS:
Verb stem ⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧ + すぎ (excess). This ～すぎ pattern is productive and works with most verbs.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {笑|わら}いすぎて⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧: stomach hurts from laughing too much
- {笑|わら}いすぎて⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: laughing until tears come out
- {笑|わら}いすぎて⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: can't breathe from laughing
- {笑|わら}いすぎ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧: face hurts from too much laughing

RELATED ～すぎ WORDS:
- ⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧すぎ: overeating
- ⟦{飲|の}みすぎ→飲みすぎ：22059_nomisugi⟧: overdrinking
- ⟦{働|はたら}き→働く：00503_hataraku⟧すぎ: overworking
- ⟦{泣|な}き→泣く：00655_naku⟧すぎ: crying too much

USAGE:
Very common in casual conversation and online communication. Often used hyperbolically to describe something extremely funny.
